people.name: Agrippa
people.line: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea

people.name: Bernice
people.line: Jewish princess, sister of King Agrippa II

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Festus
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

translations.web: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea, and greeted Festus.
translations.bsb: After several days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice came down to Caesarea to pay their respects to Festus.
translations.kjv: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
translations.asv: Now when certain days were passed, Agrippa the King and Bernice arrived at Caesarea, and saluted Festus.
